podcast.body: This was the very last song Layne Staley ever recorded, performing with his Alice in Chains bandmates in early 2002. At this point, he had lost his teeth, which had caused him to develop a lisp, and his singing voice was severely compromised due to his deteriorating health. "The name of the song is died. The last ever song recorded by Lane Staley with his Alice in Chains buddies, the track is called, died."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
